digest.component_or_area: reconciler rich-text send paths and baseline state management
propositions: Cloud and DC send paths must emit converted rich text (ADF and rendered wiki respectively) exactly once per baseline change, with state-based echo suppression replacing codec-law loops that fail on lossy codecs.

The baseline compare must normalize the LOCAL side through normalize_outbound to match decode(baseline_wire), while the emit compare stays unchanged (normalized_outbound(fit_outbound(local)) vs decode_inbound(remote_wire)), ensuring a no-edit body stays suppressed across passes.

An 8-byte change-gated rich_sha stored inline in the binding record gates a one-time GET read-back at threshold RICH_REEMIT_OBSERVE_AT=2, with the observed value reaching baseline only through _advance_baselines, preserving the sole-writer invariant.

Both DC create paths (_map_local_to_dc_fields and _translate_create_fields) must compose to_wire(fit_outbound(...)) to render wiki on CREATE matching UPDATE behavior; plain markdown on CREATE while updates render is unrecoverable.

The WikiTextCodec.normalize_outbound redefinition to decode_inbound(to_wire(t)) restores the codec law but must not shift the outbound_comments dedup key, which keeps the identity normalizer unchanged via _resolve_codec(None).

Concurrent both-sides edits keep local-wins semantics and raise outbound-field-conflict alerts; the cutover flag defaults OFF and fails closed on ImportError or missing config, degrading to plain-text behavior identical to before the cutover.
